 Anchor 
 Alicia Menendez is the anchor of MS NOW’s “On The Line with Alicia Menendez.” She is also the host of the popular podcast, “Latina to Latina.” 
A longtime host for the network, Menendez joined MS NOW in 2019 and previously hosted the network’s “The Weeknight”, “The Weekend” and “American Voices with Alicia Menendez.” 
Alicia Menendez was born in Union City, New Jersey. She graduated from Harvard College in 2005, where she delivered her undergraduate commencement address. She is a second-generation American of Cuban descent.
